Class MemoryWidget

org.jdesktop.lg3d.sg.SceneGraphObject
org.jdesktop.lg3d.sg.Node

All Implemented Interfaces:
org.jdesktop.lg3d.wg.event.LgEventSource, Widget
public class MemoryWidget extends AbstractWidget
The 3D desktop's memory widget: a thin AbstractWidget that hosts the pure-Swing MemoryCard in a SwingNode. All the sampling and painting live in the card, which the 2D desktop hosts directly.
